title: Audit Event (v1)
description: Canonical audit-event envelope (SPEC-013 R-1). Emitters (tool-gateway, platform-gateway, identity-broker, incident-service, skills-hub, agent-service) mint event_id and occurred_at and forward post-redaction events to the audit-service; the audit service stores and returns envelopes verbatim. http_request middleware events are observability data and deliberately excluded from this contract.

event_id.description: UUID minted by the emitter; correlates the stored record 1:1 with the emitter's structured log line.

occurred_at.description: Emitter-side UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of when the audited action happened.

event_type.description: Closed vocabulary of audited event types.

service.description: Emitting service name, e.g. tool-gateway, platform-gateway, identity-service.

request_id.description: Correlation identifier of the request that produced the event.

subject.description: Token subject (sub) of the user the event is attributed to, when applicable.

actor.description: Delegation actor (act.sub) — the service that acted on the user's behalf, when applicable.

roles.description: Roles of the attributed identity at event time, when applicable.

session_id.description: Agent session identifier, when the event belongs to a session.

details.description: Per-event-type payload. tool_invoked: tool_name, status, duration_ms, redacted_spans. policy_decision: action, decision, reason. token_exchange: audience, reason (rejections). session_created / session_deleted / chat_started / chat_completed: session-scoped metadata. confirmation_decided: session_id, confirm_id, tool_names, decision; approval_rule_id and approval_tier when the batch matched a require_approval rule (SPEC-030); tier-blocked approval attempts carry outcome deny with blocked=true and blocked_reason (not_a_designated_approver or self_approval). incident_triaged: incident envelope, severity_assessment, report_summary, next_steps titles, skills_cited. skill_searched: query, limit, result_count, skill_ids, optional source/tag filters. skill_retrieved: skill_id, source (hits) or reason (misses). skills_synced: source_id, source_type, ref, accepted, rejected (success) or error (failures). execution_requested (SPEC-037): confirm_id, execution_id, call_id, tool_name, args_digest, decider_user_id, owner_user_id. execution_completed: confirm_id, execution_id, call_id, tool_name, status (succeeded/failed/timeout), duration_ms, request_id. execution_rejected: confirm_id, call_id, tool_name, reason (signing_unavailable, args_digest_mismatch, request_missing). document_created (SPEC-039): document_id, document_type, own_session_count, foreign_session_count, cited_record_count, prose_status. document_published: document_id, document_type. document_read additionally carries owner_user_id (the event fires on cross-owner reads, attributed to the reader). skill_draft_generated (SPEC-044): session_id, mode (generated/skeleton), validation; incident_id when the session is incident-linked.
